title: AuthProvider::auth_header clones static header name on every call
description: auth.rs BearerAuth::auth_header and BasicAuth::auth_header (lines 157-163, 210-216): both return (AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_string(), self.header_string.clone()) — AUTHORIZATION.as_str() is a &'static str being cloned into a new String on every single request. The return type is (String, String) but the name half is always the same static string. Suggested rewrite: change AuthProvider::auth_header return type to Option<(&'static str, String)> so the header name is zero-copy, or store a HeaderName alongside the value.
